top_signals.title: USD rises after PCE data, recoups half of buyback losses
top_signals.summary: The dollar rose by the most in nearly four weeks, recovering about half of the losses triggered by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise move last week to prop up the bond market, as inflation data bolstered bets that the Federal Reserve will start raising interest rates by year end.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Iran-linked hackers expand infrastructure across Europe and Middle East, report says
top_signals.summary: Researchers said they identified servers and domains associated with several countries in Europe and the Middle East, potentially pointing to a broader targeting profile for an Iranian hacking group.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
